text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle at the Arima Kinen. 
The weather on the eve of the race: 
"Rain."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was expected that the race would be 
held on Yielding or even Heavy ground at 
this rate. However..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The rain has stopped. Track condition is 
expected to be Yielding.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It really worked, didn't it? The teru teru 
bozu everyone made for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rainbow spanning across the sky almost 
looked like... the path Narita Top Road 
was meant to follow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, it reached the pinnacle, and then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are at the intergenerational 
clash, the Arima Kinen. First, let us 
introduce the Golden Generation.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: King Halo, and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what first-rate running 
looks like!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And Grass Wonder. Making a grand entrance 
next is Japan's Supreme Commander, Special 
Week!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aiming to be the best in Japan today too!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next up are the chasers, the Umamusume of 
the rising generation taking on the 
challenge: TM Opera O and Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! As expected, whether it's the 
turn of the century or the end of the 
year, nothing beats the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not necessarily. Besides... I want to 
avoid being introduced side-by-side with 
them.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the late bloomer powerhouse, Meisho 
Doto. It seems the other entrant's arrival 
is delayed."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Oh, sorry I'm late~. Huh, isn't that me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm about to get going, okay? And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat both my own generation and 
the Golden Generation, and show them—my 
path.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The path of hard work... wait, no, um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, was there a path that suited me 
better?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I saw it clearly this morning.
Yeah, I saw it clearly this morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about it. That path 
extends beyond the summit, reaching 
straight up into the sky...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, rather than hearing about that 
path from me, it would be better for you 
to see it for yourself.
choice_data_list:
You'll understand once you're in the 
paddock, Top Road.

You'll understand once you're in the 
paddock, Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This path that I've walked... And...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This path I walk is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you, Top Road!!! 
Top Roaaaad!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ha... These... cheers are...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's finally made her entrance! 
Tremendous cheers ring out from both sides 
of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was captivated by her earnest 
running! Everyone was drawn to her 
refreshing personality! And then—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying everyone's support entirely on 
her shoulders, she has made it this far. 
Narita Top Road, her presence is 
truly...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is... cheering so passionately 
from both sides of the track...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(...I see. So this is... the path 
Trainer-san was talking about...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(This wasn't a path of mere effort alone. 
I've walked it together with so many 
friends and fans—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――A path of "light."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road seemed to have realized. 
Yes, up until now, she had—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want you to take care of yourself too. 
Because...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because you are an irreplaceable friend. 
And I'm sure there are many others who 
feel the same way I do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I held back Admire Vega, who was prepared 
to sacrifice herself to fate. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Doto-chan will become an amazing 
Umamusume in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When you feel it's the decisive moment, 
don't hesitate—push forward with 
confidence."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It encouraged Meisho Doto and gave her 
confidence. No, not just that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She illuminated countless Umamusume and 
fans with her pure brilliance, and drew 
encouragement from them in return. And so—

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Win this, Top Road!!!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Show us your absolute best smile! Right 
here, right now!"

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text: Seeing you run is what gives us strength!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (My running brings cheer...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel it... so much hope, so much 
expectation... And—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
("Desire"! I want to win! I have to win! 
More than anyone!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(If the light goes out, everyone will be 
plunged into darkness. That's why, in this 
race, no matter what—!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm Narita Top Road. I'm looking forward 
to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's move forward together, everyone. 
Along this path of light!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That pure, small light that started 
running that day is now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweeping everyone up in a torrent of 
light, she dashes across this decisive 
battlefield.
